title: AI Travel Guide
subtitle: A recommendation app for new cities: Gemini suggests places, and a scoring model I wrote decides which ones actually fit you.

meta.label: Stack
meta.value: React, Vite, Supabase, Gemini, Google Maps

sections.title: The idea
body: Most travel apps rank places by popularity. I wanted results ranked by fit: someone who loves quiet outdoor spots and someone who wants nightlife shouldn't see the same list.

Users rate themselves 1–10 on ten dimensions. Each search asks Gemini for places in the destination along with ratings on those same ten dimensions, and the app scores every place against the user's profile.

items.title: Log the search
items.body: Destination and the user's current preferences are written to user_searches.

items.title: Ask Gemini
items.body: A structured prompt returns up to 10 places, each with a 1–10 rating per category.

items.title: Resolve against the database
items.body: Each place is matched to points_of_interest by name and city — reused if it exists, inserted if new.

items.title: Score the fit
items.body: The weighted match score (below) ranks every place for this user.

items.title: Save and map
items.body: Matches are upserted to the matches table and plotted on the map.

sections.title: Try the match score
sections.caption: This is the scoring formula from the app, running live. Move your preferences and watch how each example place re-ranks.
sections.note: Example places and ratings are illustrative; in the app they come from Gemini per search.

sections.title: How the score works
lines: score = Σ similarity(c) × you(c) ÷ Σ 9 × you(c) × 100
sections.body: Each category is weighted by how much you care about it, so a mismatch on something you rated 9 costs far more than one you rated 2.

sections.title: Where the code lives
sections.caption: Lines of JavaScript/JSX by layer in src/.

sections.title: Integrations
items: Supabase (Postgres) — users, searches, places, and matches, with upserts keyed on search and place.
Google Gemini — structured JSON recommendations, with cleanup for markdown-wrapped responses.
Google Maps / Places — map rendering and place lookup.
